rationale: MEOH has already gapped up ~6.7% on strong earnings and is trading at 94% of today's range near the session high, with price stalling in the last few candles (small-bodied, declining volume) just below the $69.76 high. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.24%, VIXY +7.17%), which creates headwind for chasing a stock already extended well above VWAP ($68.14) and the 9-EMA ($68.88).
